messages: Julia (Product Designer): Hey team — quick design review for the routing policies editor. Main asks: add a 'priority lock' to freeze order during simulator runs, and clearer inline validation when rules are shadowed by higher-priority rules. I dropped a short mock in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123 - please skim. Ashwin (Engineering): +1 on the lock idea. Implementation Q: lock per-flow or global for the whole policy? Per-flow seems simpler for consistency with versioning. Also: simulator currently runs full policy; gating on each drag could be expensive. Kevin (Frontend): @Julia we can reuse the existing drag handle UI. Proposed small affordance: show a subtle 'Order locked' mini-badge and disable drag. Example aria snippet: ``` Order locked ``` Maria (Accessibility): :eyes: a11y nits: ensure the badge meets 4.5:1 contrast, add focus ring for keyboard users, and announce lock state via aria-live when toggled. Julia (Product Designer): For validation wording I'm proposing inline warning text like: ``` Rule shadowed — lower-priority rule will never match when Rule 4 is active. [Preview] ``` Clicking Preview should highlight affected traffic in the simulator view and auto-scroll to the rule. Kevin (Frontend): Simulator UX idea: add toggle 'Simulate only changes' so we run an incremental diff instead of full sim on every reorder. Visual diff could highlight rules that changed behaviour. Ashwin (Engineering): Backend can support a delta simulate endpoint. Proposal: ``` POST /policies/:id/simulate?delta=true body: { changed_rule_ids: ["r4","r7"] } ``` Will add schema and rate-limit guidance. Ravi (Product Manager): Shipping concern: locks must be persisted in policy versions and visible in audit logs (who locked, when). Also, if a lock is present during a rollout we should surface a confirmation. Julia (Product Designer): Microcopy tweak: prefer 'Order locked' vs 'Locked' — clearer in narrow columns. Tooltip: 'Prevents reordering while simulating' on hover. Maria (Accessibility): :thumbsup: also request a keyboard shortcut to toggle lock when focus is inside the rules list (suggest 'L'). Kevin (Frontend): I'll prototype the UI tonight and wire up a local delta simulate stub. cc @DesignBot for an a11y checklist run. DesignBot (bot): Automated check: Contrast OK for default badge color, missing aria-live region for lock notifications, focus-outline test failed in Chrome (2px outline missing).
